editorial.blurb: A cherished Stratford institution serving authentic, soulful Vietnamese cuisine with broth made with care and fresh ingredients that transport you home.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the veggie pho or beef pho during lunch for great specials, and don't miss their bubble tea—reviewers rave about the variety of flavors and how well leftovers keep for the next day.

topDishes.note: Rich, deeply flavorful broth made with authentic care
Perfect balance of crispy outside, soft inside with fresh ingredients
